connectors.idempotency/authored/idempote.purpose: F02: a proved Aborted attempt retains its not-attempted result without reopening dispatch.
F02: only a known-result reservation can expire; an expired generation cannot retain another result.
F02: typed namespace values preserve distinct caller, realm absence and trusted origin; this is not an admission/isolation runtime test.
F02: a Pending reservation cannot expire into another dispatch.
F02: a definitive Failed attempt retains the known refusal, not a success response.
F02: Indeterminate quarantines its key; no expiry or automatic reconciliation is allowed.

connectors.mutations/authored/deadline-a.purpose: E01: post-gate timeout cannot abort or acquire another dispatch permission.

connectors.mutations/authored/deadline-b.purpose: E01: pre-gate deadline wins abort; a late worker cannot open dispatch.

connectors.mutations/authored/definitive.purpose: F01/E11: evidence of provider refusal without a business effect is Failed, not a pre-dispatch abort.
F01/E11: a definitive success is Completed; the ledger cannot later abort or reopen.

connectors.mutations/authored/event-clai.purpose: F01: event-claim admission obeys the same uncertain-outcome lifecycle.

connectors.mutations/authored/indetermin.purpose: F01: an unknown first observation grants no retry or implicit reconciliation.

connectors.mutations/authored/recovery-a.purpose: F01: after the gate, a crash before send and a crash after send have the same durable evidence.

connectors.mutations/authored/recovery-b.purpose: F01: recovered Prepared is aborted even if its approval was spent; spend itself is a host fault-injection obligation.

connectors.mutations/authored/response-l.purpose: F01: response loss remains unknown when there was no approval to spend.
